notes.text: The NB states necessary and sufficient conditions for a generalized graph morphism to correspond to a morphism of generization for a suitable I-prime/I identification. The three live numbered conditions concern surjectivity of the vertex relation, the indicated bijection and connected fibers; an equality of marked cardinalities; and an equality for g involving a sum and h-subscript-1 of G-prime(alpha). A fourth numbered condition, including two inequalities, is crossed out across all three rows. The base letters and mixed alpha-prime/beta-prime indices in that crossed material are not regularized. The separate pencil page number reads 40, with authorship undetermined. This is a transcription and collation summary; the claimed equivalence and its sufficiency were not proved or checked.
